reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf Mild Sunscreen Relief Tube 50ml
Abib Heartleaf Mild Sunscreen Relief Tube 50ml
reviews.text: I love this formula. It’s not greasy or oily but hydrating enough to give that subtle glow. At the first application there is a little bit of a cast that slowly fades within i’d say less than 3 minutes so don’t be scared it does fade and then leaves a pretty glow. I also have extremely sensitive skin and most sunscreens never work for me. Sunscreens usually irritate and burn my skin and leave me with tiny bumps but not this sunscreen. My sensitive skin loved this and actually calmed some of the redness I had before applying it. I recommend this to my sensitive skin girlies.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個配方。唔會油笠笠，但保濕度足以帶出淡淡光澤。第一次用會有少少泛白，但會慢慢消退，大概 3 分鐘內就散，所以唔使驚，佢真係會退嘅，退完之後皮膚會留有好靚嘅光澤。我皮膚屬於極敏感，大部分防曬都唔啱我用。一般防曬通常會刺激到我皮膚，又會有灼熱感，搞到我起好多細細粒嘅粒粒，但呢隻防曬就唔會。我嘅敏感肌用完呢隻覺得好舒服，而且用之前有啲泛紅嘅地方，佢仲幫我舒緩咗。我推薦畀同我一樣係敏感肌嘅姊妹。
